tagline.en_US: Serve static sites or reverse proxy web services with Caddy, using a persistent editable Caddyfile.

description.en_US: Caddy is an extensible web server platform that enables automatic HTTPS by default. It supports HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, and can serve static sites, handle reverse proxying, and manage TLS certificates. The server can be configured through the human-friendly Caddyfile format, native JSON configuration documents, or dynamically via a JSON API.
